info.title: DataProviderMigrate - Database Schema Tool
info.description: CLI tool for DataProvider database schema migrations from YAML (SQLite + PostgreSQL).

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export C# schema class to YAML file

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to compiled assembly containing schema class (required)

options.name: --type
options.description: Fully qualified type name of schema class (required)

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Create database from YAML schema definition

options.name: --schema
options.description: Path to YAML schema definition file (required)

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to output database file (SQLite) or connection string (Postgres)

options.name: --provider
options.description: Database provider: sqlite or postgres (default: sqlite)

options.name: --allow-destructive
options.description:
Permit DROP/DISABLE operations (drift cleanup, FORCE removal,
policy drops). Off by default for safety.

options.name: --phase
options.description:
Operations to apply: all (default), structural, rls.
Use 'structural' to apply tables/columns/indexes/FKs only,
then run a separate bootstrap that creates SECURITY DEFINER
functions, then re-run with '--phase rls' to land policies
that reference those functions.
Behaviour: Inspect → Diff → Filter (by phase) → Apply. Re-running against a converged
database emits zero operations (idempotent). Drift drops require --allow-destructive.
